# Midwest Industrial Brokers

> Industrial commercial real estate brokerage for Plymouth, Ann Arbor, the I-275 corridor and greater Metro Detroit, Michigan. Led by Drake Filippis, Associate Broker with Signature Associates.

## Contact
- Broker: Drake Filippis, Associate Broker, Signature Associates
- Mobile: (248) 941-1125
- Office: (248) 799-3161
- Email: dfilippis@signatureassociates.com
- Office address: Signature Associates, One Towne Square, Suite 1200, Southfield, MI 48076
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/drake-filippis-267a104a/

## Services
- Disposition: Marketing and sale of industrial buildings and land for owners, from pricing strategy through closing.
- Acquisition: Owner user and investor acquisitions, from requirements and site search through due diligence and closing.
- Build-to-Suit: Land and build-to-suit site selection, entitlements and developer coordination for new industrial facilities.
- Tenant Representation: Site search, tour strategy and lease negotiation for warehouse, manufacturing and flex users.
- Buyer Representation: Representation of owner users buying industrial property, including financing timing and closing.
- Landlord Representation: Marketing and leasing of industrial buildings and multi tenant flex space.
- Investment Sales: Pricing, marketing and sale of industrial investment property.

## Markets served
- Plymouth, Livonia, Ann Arbor, Saline, Northville, Novi, Wixom, Metro Detroit
